cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Let Them Keep Hope
cards.instruction: Hide discouraging information because you believe hope is the only thing keeping someone able to continue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Keep the seed packets. The allotment letter says we're on the waiting list.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've covered our number. If it's another year indoors, I'm giving up gardening.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. The important bit is we're on it. Let's start tomatoes on my windowsill.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You'll get tired of them before we get a plot.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Take my sunny room. I'll move the bed; keep the packets.

mechanism: A directs competent practical work while withholding discouraging information to protect B's ability to continue.
confusable: Generic encouragement differs from actively concealing discouraging material because B threatens to give up.
comparison: Gallery rejection threatens painting; an allotment wait threatens gardening and requires tangible interim space.
seedUse: Use the threatened creative work and covered queue number, retaining evidence of concealment rather than merely optimism.
